title: Minimalist Salmon Miso Maki
description: Only nori, sushi rice and raw or cooked salmon, with a separate honey-free white miso dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: For raw sushi, use chilled salmon handled for raw consumption. Slice into two long strips of approximately 50 g each. For the cooked alternative, cook the salmon through and cool before assembly.
Cut a full nori sheet in half. Spread 80 g prepared rice on each half, keeping the far 1–1.5 cm uncovered.
Place one 50 g salmon strip along the lower third of each nori half. Roll tightly without mashing, using the bare strip to seal.
Cut each small roll into six pieces and serve 10 g chilled white miso sushi sauce per roll in a separate bowl.
notes: The sauce is a dip, not a miso glaze cooked onto salmon. No other filling or garnish is required.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
